description_html: Loose round lab-grown diamonds from 2.00–2.49 carats, each graded by IGI or GIA. Filter by color, clarity and price; every stone shows its live price.
seo_title: 2 Carat Round Lab-Grown Diamonds | Laura Milman New York
seo_description: Loose 2.00–2.49 carat round lab-grown diamonds from Laura Milman New York, graded by IGI or GIA. Filter by color and clarity; live price on every stone.
guide_html:
These are loose round lab-grown diamonds from 2.00–2.49 carats. Each stone has its own photos, a grading report from IGI or GIA and, for most, a video, so you can see exactly what you are buying. Prices are live and shown on every stone.

How big is a 2 carat round?

Carat is weight, not size, so shape matters. The round stones in this range typically measure about 8.2 mm across. A 2 carat oval of the same weight is longer, about 10.3 mm. Compare the millimetre measurements on each listing, not only the carat.

What to look for in a 2 carat round

Round brilliants carry a cut grade, and cut decides how much light the stone returns. Look for Excellent; most round stones in this size have it. Because a round has no long axis, the measurements on a listing should be nearly equal.

Most stones in this size are D to F in color and VS2 or better in clarity. Use the color and clarity filters to narrow the list.
